english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a smaller-than-normal version of an object, animal, or product.

examples.english: I bought a miniature vacuum cleaner, and it doesn't take up space on my desk.
examples.traditional: 我買咗個迷你吸塵機，擺喺書枱都唔阻地方。
